scenes.title_cn: 废片的问题：发灰、不通透、肤色脏
scenes.title_en: What Makes a Photo Look Dead: Flat, Muddy, Dirty Skin
scenes.context: 被评价为『废片』的照片通常有三个问题：整体发灰没有层次、画面不通透、肤色偏脏偏黄。这三者都源于曝光与白平衡的基础没做好。
sentences: 废片的第一特征，是整体发灰。
The first sign of a dead photo is that it looks flat.
flat（发灰/平淡）
第二个问题是不通透。
The second problem is a lack of clarity.
clarity（通透感）
肤色脏，其实是白平衡在捣乱。
Dirty skin tone is actually your white balance misbehaving.
white balance（白平衡）
paraphrase: The image has no depth or life to it.
It's an exposure and white-balance issue at heart.
scenes.speak: The first sign of a dead photo is that it looks flat. The second problem is a lack of clarity. Dirty skin tone is actually your white balance misbehaving.

scenes.title_cn: 三步法：提曝光、校白平衡、分离肤色
scenes.title_en: Three Steps: Lift Exposure, Fix White Balance, Separate Skin
scenes.context: 一分钟流程：第一步拉高曝光让画面透亮；第二步用白平衡工具取皮肤中间灰，去除偏黄；第三步用蒙版单独提亮肤色，让皮肤白亮透而背景不过曝。
sentences: 第一步，拉高曝光，让画面先透亮起来。
Step one, lift the exposure so the image brightens up.
lift exposure（提亮曝光）
第二步，用白平衡工具校准肤色。
Step two, use the white-balance tool to correct the skin.
correct（校准）
第三步，只提亮皮肤，背景不跟着亮。
Step three, brighten the skin only — leave the background alone.
leave alone（不处理）
paraphrase: Get the base exposure right and the photo wakes up.
Target the skin with a mask so only it lifts.
scenes.speak: Step one, lift the exposure so the image brightens up. Step two, use the white-balance tool to correct the skin. Step three, brighten the skin only — leave the background alone.

scenes.title_cn: 细节：别让皮肤提亮过头
scenes.title_en: The Fine Print: Don't Over-Brighten the Skin
scenes.context: 白亮透不等于过曝，皮肤的高光要保留纹理。如果蒙版边缘生硬，皮肤会像贴在背景上。最后一步是降低蒙版强度或加一点柔光过渡。
sentences: 白亮透不是过曝。
Bright and clear is not the same as blown out.
blown out（过曝）
蒙版边缘太硬，皮肤会像贴上去的。
If the mask edge is too hard, the skin looks pasted on.
mask edge（蒙版边缘）
最后给皮肤留一点自然的过渡。
Finish with a soft transition so the skin feels natural.
transition（过渡）
paraphrase: Keep the texture in the highlights — don't cook the skin.
Feather the mask so nothing looks cut out.
scenes.speak: Bright and clear is not the same as blown out. If the mask edge is too hard, the skin looks pasted on. Finish with a soft transition so the skin feels natural.

practice: 「提亮曝光让画面通透」怎么表达？
Lift the exposure for more clarity.
「用白平衡校肤色」用英文怎么说？
Correct the skin tone with the white-balance tool.
Bright and clear isn't the same as blown out.
pitfalls: Brighten the whole image and blow out the skin.
Lift exposure, then target skin with a mask.
Overall lifting loses texture and makes skin plastic.
Skip white balance and fix color later.
Fix white balance before tweaking color.
No amount of grading fixes a wrong base white balance.
Make the mask edge razor sharp.
Feather the mask for a soft transition.
Hard edges make skin look pasted on.
Push 'bright white' as far as it goes.
Stop before the highlights lose detail.
Over-brightened skin reads as unnatural and cheap.
shifts: 把废片归因于调色不够狠
意识到发灰/不通透源于曝光与白平衡基础
